tagline.en_US: Run the Pyroscope server and its UI for receiving and exploring application profiles.

description.en_US: Grafana Pyroscope is an open-source continuous profiling platform designed to surface performance insights from your applications. It stores, processes, and serves profiling data to help identify and analyze CPU, memory, and I/O usage. Users can inspect flame graphs and drill down into specific services to perform root cause analysis and eliminate performance bottlenecks.
